title: Hard Reading
details: Angie Koks needs to finish a chapter for class, but her study partner is just such a sexy distraction that she has to have a piece of him before she can continue reading anything. Once he starts making moves it's clear that she needs something more substantial than a hard cover book. Once he is engorged and inside her there is no holding back the sweet purrs of a satisfied lady. She tries to suck all the wisdom from that hard shaft, but instead gets a bit on her eye! Should have kept the reading glasses on...
